notes: A national occupational standard and competency-based curriculum, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme.
Stores the 13 competency units only; the curriculum modules and learning hours are not stored and no overall course duration is stated.

The NVQ portal also lists the older K72S002 'Computer Network Technician' standard, whose title matches NYSC COURSE-022 exactly; its only published revision dates from 2005/2011, so it was not stored. K72S015 is the current networking standard (first revision August 2026).
Both NVQ Level 4 packaging passages are stored: the network-and-security package excludes the hardware units U03 and U04.
scope_verbatim: National certificate at NVQ Level- 4 in the occupation of Computer Systems and Network Technician (Network & Network Security) will be awarded to those who are competent in units U01+U02+ U05 + U06+U07+ U08 + U09 +BU01+ BU02+ BU03+ BU04 – K72S015Q3L4

National certificate at NVQ Level- 4 in the occupation of Computer Systems and Network Technician (Hardware, Network & Network Security) will be awarded to those who are competent in units U01+ U02+ U03+ U04 + U05+ U06 + U07+ U08 + U09 + BU01+ BU02+ BU03+ BU04 – K72S015Q4L4
